prompts.prompt: In the clock repair shop, Esra found a brass gear with an etched triangle. She placed it in a tiny envelope to return it to the watchmaker.
At the ice rink, Cato discovered a wool mitten under the scoreboard. He wrote the rink number on a paper tag before bringing it to the front desk.
A sketchbook marked with a blue spiral lay near the orchard gate. Nell carried it to the garden office without opening its pages.
At a boat workshop, Anika held a measuring tape while her partner Bo cut a plank. She waited for him to mark the length before moving the tape.
Mei and Rafi were cleaning a telescope together. Mei handled the soft cloth while Rafi kept the lens cap safe in a case.
The choir director asked Nila to show a shy newcomer where to stand. Nila made room beside her and pointed to the music stand.
A paper boat was stuck in a narrow rain gutter. Finn looked for a smooth stick so he could lift it without tearing the paper.
The lantern at the dock flickered because its plug was loose. Eren switched it off before adjusting the cable.
A box of paints slid toward the edge of a table. Rhea caught the corner and moved the box onto a dry tray.
Mila was told to lock the bicycle shed before turning out the yard light. She checked the latch as the sun went down.
At a bird sanctuary, Theo had to feed the smaller birds first and open the larger pen only after sunrise. He arranged the bowls in order.
The festival steward asked Kian to roll out the red carpet after the rain stopped. He kept it wrapped while the clouds passed.
